# A 542 cap in PG(8,3).
# Quantavane, November 2026: found from Edel's 541-cap in PG(8,3) (yvesedel.de, Matritzen/CAPs), in its
# coordinates; 533 of its points are kept (8 removed) and 9 points are new.
# The 542 points are the columns of this 9 x 542 matrix over GF(3), one row per coordinate x0, ..., x8;
# it is a check matrix of a linear [542,533,4]_3 code.
# Field: GF(3), the integers modulo 3, written 0, 1, 2.
# Columns: every point is scaled so that its last nonzero coordinate is 1. Columns 1-533 are the points of
# Edel's cap that are kept, columns 534-542 the new points, each group in lexicographic order of (x0, ..., x8).
